title: Man. Post. Cap. X: PLAC — those GAR reasons are null; no room left to doubt
pass_a_gloss: Placeus: how empty those reasons are we take ourselves to have made plain by our replies and arguments, so that no room for doubt remains.
pass_b_english: PLAC. But as for how null those reasons are, we judge that we have made it so clear by our replies and our reasons that no place of doubting remains.
source_text: PLAC. Nos vero quam illae rationes nullae sint, nostris & responsionibus & rationibus ita clarum fecisse arbitramur, ut nullus sit reliquus dubitandi locus.
notes: Cap. X GAR densify section 666 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 359–360 tip).
